source.english_context: Unit 12 Work, Pay, and Workplace Norms Goal: understand job basics, schedules, pay words, and polite workplace questions. Daily Life English What is my schedule this week? When is payday? Can you show me how to clock in? I need to ask about my pay stub. Vocabulary shift the hours a person works payday the day workers are paid pay stub a document showing pay and deductions overtime extra work hours beyond regular hours manager a person who leads workers break a short rest time at work US Customs Work permission, tax forms, pay rules, and benefits depend on your situation. Ask questions early if you do not understand a schedule or task. It is normal to confirm instructions: "Just to make sure, you want me to..." Dialogue Student: Could you show me how to clock in? Manager: Sure. Use this screen and enter your ID. Student: Thank you. What time is my break? Manager: Your break is at 11:00. Student: Got it. Thank you.

japanese_explanation.heading: 職場では確認が力になる
points: 勤務時間、休憩、給料日、制服、遅刻連絡の方法は最初に確認します。
分からない仕事は、黙って間違えるより、短く確認する方がよいです。Just to make sure... は便利です。
働く資格、税金、残業、福利厚生は状況で違います。重要な点は雇用主や専門家に確認しましょう。
japanese_explanation.practice: Just to make sure, you want me to clock in here?

existing_simplified_chinese.heading: 工作中确认很重要
points: 一开始要确认班表、休息时间、发薪日、制服和迟到时怎么联系。
不懂任务时，简短确认比默默做错更好。Just to make sure... 很有用。
工作许可、税、加班和福利会因个人情况不同。重要问题要向雇主或专业人士确认。
existing_simplified_chinese.practice: Just to make sure, you want me to clock in here?

ja.heading: 職場では確認が力になる
points: 勤務時間、休憩、給料日、制服、遅刻連絡の方法は最初に確認します。
分からない仕事は、黙って間違えるより、短く確認する方がよいです。Just to make sure... は便利です。
働く資格、税金、残業、福利厚生は状況で違います。重要な点は雇用主や専門家に確認しましょう。

ko.heading: 직장에서는 확인하는 것이 중요합니다
points: 근무 시간, 휴식 시간, 급여일, 유니폼, 그리고 지각 시 연락 방법을 미리 확인하세요.
모르는 업무는 침묵하고 실수하는 것보다 짧게 확인하는 것이 좋습니다. "Just to make sure..." 표현이 유용합니다.
근무 자격, 세금, 초과 근무, 복리후생은 상황에 따라 다릅니다. 중요한 사항은 고용주나 전문가에게 확인하십시오.

zh-Hans.heading: 在工作中确认很重要
points: 首先确认工作时间、休息时间、发薪日、制服以及迟到时如何联系。
对于不明白的工作，与其默默做错，不如简短地确认一下。"Just to make sure..." 很有用。
工作资格、税收、加班和福利待遇因情况而异。重要的事项请向雇主或专业人士确认。

es.heading: La confirmación es clave en el lugar de trabajo
points: Al principio, confirme los horarios de trabajo, los descansos, el día de pago, el uniforme y cómo informar si llega tarde.
Para tareas que no entienda, es mejor confirmar brevemente que callar y cometer un error. La frase "Just to make sure..." es útil.
El permiso de trabajo, los impuestos, las horas extras y los beneficios varían según su situación. Confirme los puntos importantes con su empleador o un profesional.

pt-BR.heading: A confirmação é fundamental no local de trabalho
points: No início, confirme o horário de trabalho, os intervalos, o dia de pagamento, o uniforme e como notificar em caso de atraso.
Para tarefas que você não entenda, é melhor confirmar brevemente do que ficar em silêncio e cometer um erro. A frase "Just to make sure..." é útil.
A permissão de trabalho, impostos, horas extras e benefícios variam de acordo com a sua situação. Confirme os pontos importantes com seu empregador ou um profissional.
